zh: "正确的位置"指的是按身高升序排好之后，每个位置上应该出现的那个身高。
复制一份数组并排序，得到目标序列；某个位置正确，当且仅当原数组在该位置的值与排序后同一位置的值相等。
逐个位置比较原数组与排序后的数组，统计不相等的位置个数并输出。
en: The correct position of a student is defined by the order you get after sorting the heights in ascending order.
Copy the array and sort the copy to get the target sequence; a position is correct exactly when the original value there equals the sorted value at the same position.
Compare the original and sorted arrays position by position, count the positions where they differ, and print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort to get the target sequence, then compare position by position.

## Proof of Correctness

A position is correct if and only if its value equals the value at the same position after sorting; counting the unequal positions gives exactly what the problem asks for.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
